name: subscription-token-ratelimit
description: Enforces the token limits of the caller's subscription plan on LLM APIs, counting the total, prompt or completion tokens of each response with a counter per subscription. Token counts are read using the LLM provider template, as token-based-ratelimit does. Runs after subscription-validation v2, which records the subscription and plan, and delegates counting to the advanced-ratelimit engine with in-memory or Redis backends.
